environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Subnet route table contains only local VPC CIDR route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumers connect via interface VPC endpoint in their own VPC. The endpoint service has an allowlist of specific AWS account IDs (principal ARNs) that can create endpoint connections, and requires manual acceptance. The NLB target group health check path is /health. There is no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering to any VPC with internet access in the account. The subnet's network ACL denies all inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 except from the 10.0.0.0/8 range. DNS resolution for the service is only available via the VPC endpoint's private DNS name.

config.network: isolated subnet, route table: 10.0.0.0/16 -> local only
config.nlb: internal, registered as PrivateLink endpoint service
config.dns: private hosted zone only, no public DNS
